events.comment: Template: a fight-ready Deep Forest arena with no boss. To make a new fight, duplicate this scene, add the boss objects, put them in the Enemy and EnemyHitbox groups, and link the boss's events sheet at the end.
Shared combat rules. Runs before the Samurai events so they can react on the same frame.

Leaf Ranger death hold: his HP reached 0 on his last life without a posture break (Combat_Shared just set JustDied). Instead of dying at once (JustDied and JustLostLife are both cleared, or his phase 2 "lost a life" event would fire and undo the break), he drops into the kneel (the first 8 frames of his death) for StunDuration seconds (2.5) with the deathblow orb up. HP stays just above 0 so the life is not taken yet, and his arrows and thorns are cleared. A deathblow from a real posture break (Player.IsDeathblow) is left alone. DeathHold: 0 not yet, 1 kneeling, 2 the hold ran out, 3 the death animation was moved past the kneel.

Leaf Ranger death hold: no deathblow came before the stun ran out, so he finishes dying on his own. HP 0 lets Combat_Shared take the last life next frame, and clearing JustRecovered stops his sheet from standing him up.

Leaf Ranger life hold: his HP reached 0 with a life to spare (phase 1). Combat_Shared already took the life (JustLostLife), which would send him straight into phase 2 with no chance of a deathblow. Instead he gets the life back and kneels at 0.01 HP, posture-broken, with the deathblow orb, like the death hold on his last life. Not during a deathblow: the deathblow takes its life this same way, and that one must stand.

Leaf Ranger life hold: no deathblow came before the stun ran out, so he loses the life anyway. HP 0 lets Combat_Shared take it next frame, and his sheet's "lost a life" event then starts phase 2. LifeHold 2 keeps the hold above from catching it again.
Leaf Ranger life hold: the life is gone (to the deathblow or the timeout), so the hold is over.

Leaf Ranger death hold: plain hits cannot land while he kneels, so only the deathblow (which ignores Invulnerable) or the timeout ends him. His sheet's kneel event clears Invulnerable, so this runs after it.
Leaf Ranger life hold: the same, plain hits cannot land while he kneels at 0 HP, or one would take the life without a deathblow.
Leaf Ranger death hold: his sheet starts Ranger_death from frame 0, but he is already kneeling on its 8th frame. Carry on from frame 8, so he does not pop up and fall again.
Scene start: hide the red Invisible_Wall colliders. The Samurai sheet does this in his scenes, but this scene does not include it.
Arena: Deep Forest ambience (light shafts and fireflies). Its objects are in the "Arena Deep Forest" folder, on the Background layer behind the floor.
